scripts.build: vite build && node ../scripts/precompress-dist.mjs dist && node ../scripts/check-build-bundle.mjs dist && node ../scripts/check-page-budget.mjs dist --chunk=App --entry=src/router/index.ts --entry=src/views/Demo/index.vue --max-bytes=4000000
scripts.build:jsp: vite build --config vite.config.jsp.ts --mode production.jsp && node ../scripts/precompress-dist.mjs dist-jsp && node ../scripts/check-build-bundle.mjs dist-jsp

scripts.build:standalone: vite build --mode production.standalone && node ../scripts/precompress-dist.mjs dist && node ../scripts/check-build-bundle.mjs dist && node ../scripts/check-page-budget.mjs dist --chunk=App --entry=src/router/index.ts --entry=src/views/Demo/index.vue --entry=src/layout/MainLayout.vue --max-bytes=4000000
